hooks.name: Declarative and catalog gate on stop
hooks.description: Final gate when the agent stops: no chapter/level/comix page named in code, and compiled chapter & comix catalogs match disk. Under 1 s, report-only.

action.command: node scripts/quality/check-declarative.mjs; node scripts/harness/generate-chapter.mjs --check; node scripts/harness/generate-comix.mjs --check
